text: Assumption: The function object operates statelessly and therefore allows thread-safe parallel read accesses to the same vector — is this correct?

assumption: The function object operates statelessly and therefore allows thread-safe parallel read accesses to the same vector.
rationale: The function call operator operator() is const noexcept and takes the argument by const&; the absence of member states is the usual standard for std::hash specializations.
